programs.description: When Suman suffers an accident, Meghna, his current wife, and Shubhra, his former wife, come together to manage the critical situation.
After failing to pay off his debts, the owner of a construction company sends his sons on an adventurous journey to assist him in performing a task.
Binoy is attracted to his beautiful colleague Gayatri, but he suffers in love due to a peculiar condition that causes him to be afraid of attractive women.
A small-town girl moves to the city to realise her dreams and seeks help from a male friend to pose as her husband in order to rent an apartment.
Shibaji, a famous Indian boxer, loses fame overnight when he meets with a tragic accident. After losing his title, he fights all odds to revive his career and become a champion again.
A young couple must overcome internal conflicts and a series of problems that arise due to a criminal accusation in order to be united in love.
Captain Dibyendu Rakshit finds himself in trouble when a bout of turbulence damages the plane's engines. He must find a way to land safely before it is too late.
Finding solace in magic, Indra keeps his problems at bay. However, his life takes a turn when he meets Kirti and their connection unveils a past life story.
Soham is interested in the history of Bengal and soon meets Ashutosh, a historian, who tells him about a puzzle that his friend sent him which will lead to a rare artefact.
Three friends launch a ghost-hunting venture using a strange device, only to find themselves entangled in a series of eerie encounters they never expected.
A wealthy Parsi businessman hires Pragya Paromita, aka Mitin Masi, a detective, to look for his son, who is kidnapped on his school premises.

Aditya, a commitment-phobic hotelier, loves Esha, his innocent employee. Things get complicated when Esha's past comes to the fore, and he realises that Prachi, his associate, loves him.
Rocky, a thug and a mercenary, accidentally reaches Kashmir where he falls in love with Nandini. However, when she learns about his profession, all hell breaks loose.
On their way to Siliguri, India, Rahul and Ria bump into each other. While Rahul plans to sell a stolen necklace, Ria is excited to meet her boyfriend.
Riya meets Sneha on a flight back home, and they strike up a conversation. Surprisingly, Sneha's fiancé turns out to be a lookalike of Riya's boyfriend, leaving her in a state of shock.
Ram, who spreads positivity and happiness, fights against Raavan, an evil man who ruthlessly ends the lives of many individuals.

Leela befriends Krishna after using missed calls to scam him into recharging her phone and the two become close. However, he becomes the prime suspect when she goes missing.
Krishnendu, a PhD scholar researching on legendary actor Uttam Kumar, decides to summon his ghost through planchette to win over Sohini, a girl who rejected him.
Two researchers and a doctor set out to find a mythical substance called red mercury to solve the fossil fuel crisis and save a child's life.
A group of friends on vacation in Darjeeling agree to help a scientist protect his valuable formula from a Japanese spy. However, they soon suspect that all may not be as it seems.

A man gives shelter to a girl who has been a victim of rape and has also witnessed a murder. He gives her hope to live again, and they fall in love with each other.
After adopting the name Tiger, Indrajit Sen, a grief-stricken college professor, decides to fight corrupt public servants and avenge his son's death.
A powerful man kidnaps Haripada, a common man, and forces him to pretend to be his girlfriend's lover so that he can mislead his suspicious and jealous wife.
Ajit Singh is the leader of a night guard party in a town in Punjab and lives with his wife, son and daughter. He and his family get killed by a terrorist leader.
Teenagers enjoy their school life to the fullest, until a boy gets murdered in a classroom, and everyone in the institution comes under the radar of suspicion.
Strangers Sudarshan and Kuntol cross paths and talk about the upheavals in their lives and come up with strange solutions that have unreal consequences.
Rajarshi, an internationally renowned director, comes to Kolkata for a short sabbatical and reunites with the people he had left behind in life to pursue filmmaking.
Under an enormous debt, Bhupati Ray strives to sell his inherited palace while withholding its paranormal truth. Upon finding a buyer, one of his ancestors' ghosts creates a chaotic hurdle.
Sohini, a Bengali woman, gets married to Ashwin, a man from another community. When they feel lost in their lives, they decide to understand each other's perspectives.
Meher Ali, a Muslim boy who lives with his widowed mother, falls in love with a Hindu girl. However, his life turns upside down when he gets convicted as a terrorist and imprisoned for life.

A young man falls in love with the granddaughter of a retired colonel. When he decides to confess his love, he feels heartbroken upon discovering her relationship with another man.
Detective Byomkesh Bakshi witnesses a murder when he attends a stage play. Soon, he investigates the case with his confidant and gradually unearths a story of love, betrayal and revenge.
After getting married in a contemporary family, a woman rebels against the maltreatment of her in-laws. Moreover, she vows to take action and gets help from another educated family.
When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.

A married couple sets off on a leisure trip to Kalimpong and stays in an attractive bungalow, but unexplainable incidents at the place lead them to face the truth behind an unsettled murder.
Borun Chakraborty, a seemingly irritable and lonely old man, becomes the centre of attention in his family and the neighbourhood when he receives a letter from a famous former friend.

Alok and Mina decide to get married because of their mutual obsession over hair. But their love is tested when Alok starts losing hair due to an unknown hair oil.
Tarini Khuro narrates three ghost stories to a group of children from his fan club, which involves a ghost hunter, Anathbandhu, a mysterious entity, Simon, and a friendly ghost from the 19th century.
While helping a family member diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease, a family learns to look at things from a different perspective and in turn mend their relationships with each other.
